summary: piterfly is a build of the SLOOP groovebox that stores 24 patterns and longer song arrangements, at the cost of one user sample bank. Not yet tested on a physical FM-1.
features: 24 patterns in six banks of four, instead of four
Song order of 128 entries, each 1 to 64 bars
Three user sample banks; the fourth's space holds patterns
All 64 steps shown in rows of 16 on overview screens
Per-track MIDI THRU switches; save status shown as PENDING or SAVED
Otherwise SLOOP's engines, drum kits, sequencer and MIDI

headings: play it live: hold a button, touch a key
lights for playing in the dark 2.3
the menu: settings of the fm-1
usb audio: record the fm-1 on a computer
